title: Remark A.5: invariance under a subspace of dimension ≥ n forces a plane indicator
statement: Let P, n, Q ∈ ℕ, let ψ : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be locally μH[n]-integrable, and let L ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim L ≥ n such that ψ(y + λx) = ψ(x) for all y ∈ L, λ > 0 and x ∈ ℝ^P. Then there is an n-dimensional linear subspace L' ⊆ ℝ^P with ψ = ψ(0)·1_{L'} everywhere on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n Q : ℕ) (ψ : Euclid P → Euclid Q) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), LocallyIntegrable ψ μH[(n : ℝ)] → n ≤ Module.finrank ℝ L → (∀ y ∈ L, ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ x, ψ (y + lam • x) = ψ x) → ∃ L' : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ L' = n ∧ ψ = Set.indicator (L' : Set (Euclid P)) (fun _ => ψ 0)
